rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for trembling from cold, fear, or nervousness.

example.english: I get so nervous about going on stage that I shiver.
example.traditional: 我一聽到要上台，就緊張到發抖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teng1 dou2 jiu3 soeng5 toi4 zau6 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 faat3 dau2

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression especially when someone is visibly shivering from cold or fright.

example.english: I shiver whenever I see a snake.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 se4 zau6 daa2 laang5 zan3

rows.note: Use this pattern when the shivering is specifically caused by being very cold.

example.english: The heater was not on in my room last night, so I was so cold that I began to shiver.
example.traditional: 尋晚間房冇開暖氣，我凍到震。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 gaan1 fong2 mou5 hoi1 nyun5 hei3 ngo5 dung3 dou3 zan3
